title: Rokad Web
description: Rokad — a modern multi-page platform built with Next.js 14, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion. Features news, events, alumni, honors, blog, and fully responsive pages, now live in production.

title: DigiKala
description: A responsive clone of the DigiKala e-commerce website built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, including product listings, navigation, and a clean shopping interface.

title: Porskad
description: Porskad — a dedicated form and survey management system for educational institutes. Built with React, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion, featuring an interactive admin dashboard, embeddable forms, and a responsive UI.

title: Rokad College
description: Rokad College — a modern online learning platform built with React 18, Tailwind CSS, and Swiper. Features hero sections, course pillars, statistics, and fully responsive pages, now live in production.

title: Crypto Market
description: A cryptocurrency market dashboard built with React, Vite and Tailwind CSS. Live CoinGecko data through a shared context, instant currency switching, dynamic coin pages with routing, and interactive price charts.

title: NovaBank
description: A modern banking and payments landing page built with React, Vite, and Tailwind CSS. Features a hero with layered card artwork, feature grid, billing and business sections, client logos, testimonials, and a fully responsive layout.

title: Ubisoft
description: A responsive clone of the Ubisoft website built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, featuring a modern UI, interactive sections, and smooth user experience.

title: Khodrochini 110
description: A Persian WordPress site for a specialised Chinese-car repair workshop in Tehran. Custom theme with service pages, workshop gallery, FAQ, blog, and local SEO structure, all fully right-to-left.

title: Study Timer
description: A study tracker and exam countdown app built with Next.js, React, and Supabase. Features task management, study session tracking, and a clean modern interface.

title: Sabz Learn
description: A modern online learning platform inspired by Sabz Learn, built with React and Tailwind CSS, featuring course browsing, reusable components, responsive design, and a clean user experience.

title: Todo App
description: A task management application built with React and Tailwind CSS, allowing users to create, organize, edit, and track daily tasks through a clean and responsive interface.
